scope.source_scan: Selected case source partitions only; repair consumes the private audited cache

source_acceptance: Exact hospital-specific ITEMID allowlist; keyword discovery alone is insufficient
Documented use or removal requires D_ITEMS LABEL before the separator and source VALUE to equal the reviewed assertion phrase, ignoring only whitespace and case
Patient and admission must match; an explicit STAY_ID must match
CHARTTIME must be within the half-open actual ICU stay and at or before the replay horizon
Known availability requires valid STORETIME at or after CHARTTIME and strictly before ICU exit
Orders, maintenance-only actions, insertion-depth measurements, unknown categorical codes, and unrelated results do not establish device attachment

documented_use.event_minute: Equal to chart_minute; not an insertion timestamp
documented_use.active: True means the source explicitly documented use at that observation; it is not current attachment

documented_removal.meaning: The source documents removal of this device at the observation time; subsequent absence is not established and tube extubation does not imply ventilator OFF

historical_device_observations.availability_known: Keep available_minute. A retrospective CHARTTIME observation may be shown at or before selected time, but do not claim contemporaneous information availability before available_minute
historical_device_observations.availability_unknown: Omit available_minute; retain missing_storetime, invalid_storetime, or store_before_chart reason. The recorded-use/removal observation may be shown at its CHARTTIME with availability explicitly unknown
historical_device_observations.same_time_conflict: Opposing active values for the same device type and chart minute are flagged, never silently resolved

consumer_invariants: Historical device observations may have positive or removed visual styling explicitly labeled as recorded use/removal at CHARTTIME; they do not populate current status flags, transfer colors, or frozen-time AI facts
A historical observation never establishes continuous use until ICU discharge
No matching evidence means unconfirmed, never device-free
Device maintenance such as ventilator circuit-water removal is not device removal
Explicit OFF is accepted only for the separately reviewed literal ON/OFF CHARTEVENTS item; zero ECMO flow does not establish absence
The documentary-use repair does not change vital series, patient identity, cohort selection, or other clinical records

v2_transition_audit.source: Parent agent reported cache-only audit results; final v2 recovery counts remain in the private remote repair_audit.json

scenario_visual_state.basis: Latest explicit CHARTTIME record at or before selected replay time
scenario_visual_state.positive: Keep the corresponding original pictogram illuminated until a later explicit OFF/removal record or same-time conflict
scenario_visual_state.negative: Show the exact device OFF/removal; endotracheal-tube extubation does not imply ventilator OFF
scenario_visual_state.missing: Unknown when no linked record exists; do not invent absence
scenario_visual_state.time_label: Tooltip identifies last observed time; this is last-record replay state, not proof of continuous attachment
scenario_visual_state.daily_events: Only confirmed timed CPR and surgical records on the same source calendar date
